properties_valuation.note: Individual property valuations tie exactly to the audited Portfolio Statement subtotals (REIT IP 6,240,832 excl ROU; BT IP 359,295; BT freehold L&B 555,907). Robertson House leasehold L&B 353,906 (BT, taken from p146 block) held separately. ROU assets 240,546 are not a property row.

inferred.scope: Somerset Olympic Tower Property Tianjin / Citadines Karasuma-Gojo Kyoto / Infini Garden
inferred.basis: Valuation shown as '-' in the FY2024 Portfolio Statement: Somerset Olympic Tower reclassified to assets held for sale (Note 14, status=held_for_sale); Karasuma-Gojo Kyoto and Infini Garden divested during FY2024 (status=divested). Null is source-faithful.

Portfolio Statement discloses tenure as term + remaining-term (no expiry date) and no per-property operating metrics; per-property occupancy/revenue/NPI are not disclosed for this trust. Left null (structurally absent).

columns_never_fillable.basis: Hospitality trust (serviced residences/hotels/rental housing/student accommodation). The audited Portfolio Statement discloses only description/location/tenure/term/remaining-term/valuation per property. No per-property area, occupancy, revenue or NPI is disclosed (portfolio operates on management-contract / master-lease / MCMGI models with a MAS waiver on lease-expiry disclosure), so these are structurally null. Tenure is disclosed as term + remaining term, never an explicit expiry date.

data_with_no_home.note: Right-of-use assets 240,546 ($'000, p143) are included in the Stapled Group's Statement-of-Financial-Position 'Investment properties and IPUD' line (6,481,378 REIT / 6,840,673 Stapled) but are not an individual property row. The Robertson House leasehold land & buildings (353,906) is captured as a property (BT-owned, Singapore).

parsing_traps.shifted_tenure_columns: Several UK/US/Singapore rows split the tenure into an extra 'term of lease' token (e.g. '99 years | 88 years | 89 years'), shifting the value columns right. Valuation was located as the first monetary/dash cell after the tenure block rather than by fixed index; all group subtotals reconcile exactly (see reconciliation.properties_valuation).
parsing_traps.robertson_house: The Robertson House row prints Stapled/REIT columns as dashes on p140; its valuation 353,906 was taken from the dedicated 'Leasehold land and buildings' block on p146.
parsing_traps.dash_valuations: '-' valuations denote divested (Karasuma-Gojo Kyoto, Infini Garden) or held-for-sale (Somerset Olympic Tower Tianjin) assets — kept as rows with null market_valuation and appropriate status.
